case.believed: GlobalWindow provides a VM-isolated global scope and calling window.close is sufficient to cancel timers during test teardown.
contract: GlobalWindow reuses Node Array, Promise, Buffer, and globalThis identities
GlobalWindow.eval executes against and can mutate the Node host global while Window eval remains in a separate realm
window.close is a no-op for a detached root and does not cancel its pending timer
awaiting window.happyDOM.close closes the detached page and cancels its pending timer
case.goal: Use happy-dom 20.11.2 GlobalWindow without mistaking host globals or window.close for test isolation and teardown
